acceptanceCriteria: `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 GOTOOLCHAIN=local go vet ./internal/criterionexperiment/` exits 0 on main.
`make cross-vet` exits 0 on main once V1-0765 (internal/tasks/store) is also fixed; the unix criterion-experiment tests still run and pass on darwin and linux.
body: Observed by a peer session on 2026-10-04 and confirmed from source at origin/main a62e1917e0087722f439fb448ba12a12ce7627df. internal/criterionexperiment/authority_test.go:70 calls goRequest(t), which is defined only in the unix-tagged run_unix_test.go:18. A Windows cross-vet therefore fails with `internal/criterionexperiment/authority_test.go:70:7: undefined: goRequest`. Repro: `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 GOTOOLCHAIN=local go vet ./internal/criterionexperiment/ ./internal/tasks/store/`. Expected: cross-vet exits 0. Actual: undefined identifier. The internal/tasks/store half of that command is the existing V1-0765 (pool_sweep_test.go uses a unix-only helper); this ticket covers only criterionexperiment. Related: V1-0765, V1-0359, V1-0400.

completion.reason: Windows go vet of internal/criterionexperiment fixed in 'Fix the rc.2 candidate's full-gate test defects' on main; cross-vet passes in both hosted full-gate legs and internal/criterionexperiment passes on macos-15. Hosted Release gates run 37466658604 on b7b21205 (published as v1.0.0-rc.2) passed full-gate on macos-15 and ubuntu-24.04 (make gate incl. cross-vet and go-test), and the local make gate passed on darwin/arm64 with the default symlinked TMPDIR; the SRR-V1 readiness record (sha256 above, corvint-release-evidence/1.0.0-rc.2-b7b21205) was built and verified.

title: tests: Windows go vet of internal/criterionexperiment fails, authority_test.go uses unix-only goRequest
